title: ZKupid
tagline: ZKupid: An anonymous rose exchange on the blockchain using zero-knowledge proofs for Valentine's Day.
description: ZKupid: An anonymous rose exchange on the blockchain using zero-knowledge proofs for Valentine's Day. Choose roses, prove age and gender with AnonAadhaar, capture intention with cryptography, and enjoy secure, private transactions. Anonymity is prioritized, making it a unique and suspenseful digital rose exchange.
how_its_made:
Circom Proofs: Implement zero-knowledge proof to prove your year of birth and gender with anon-aadhaar
Smart Contract: Verify proofs onchain and mint NFT with gender and year of birth
UI: Use AnonAadhaar Provider React component
Deployment: Contract deployed on scroll sepolia testnet
Match making: Use fruity-lib to do private set intersection on hobbies of users and come up with plausible matches
